title: Work Done, Elasticity and Hooke's Law

flashcard_questions.q: The energy transferred when a force moves an object through a distance, measured in joules (J).
A contact force that opposes the motion of an object moving through or over a surface.
A change in the shape of an object caused by an applied force.

flashcard_questions.a: The point beyond which the extension of a spring is no longer directly proportional to the applied force.
flashcard_questions.q: What is meant by 'limit of proportionality'?

flashcard_questions.a: A measure of the stiffness of a spring, in newtons per metre (N/m). A higher value means a stiffer spring.
